questions.text: What is the only organ in the human body dedicated entirely and exclusively to pleasure?
questions.explanation: The clitoris contains over 8,000 to 10,000 sensory nerve endings and exists solely to provide sensory pleasure!

questions.text: Which powerful muscular organ, responsible for bringing new life into the world, can expand its internal capacity up to 500 times during pregnancy?
questions.explanation: Made of remarkably strong smooth muscle tissue, the uterus grows from the size of a small pear to holding a full-term baby.

questions.text: What internal parts of the clitoris (known as the 'legs') extend deep inside the pelvis, wrapping around the vaginal structures like an iceberg beneath the surface?
questions.explanation: Most of the clitoris is hidden internally, with its erectile tissue 'legs' (crura) spanning up to 4 inches inside the pelvis.

questions.text: What is the name of the dynamic internal canal that is self-cleaning, expands during arousal and childbirth, and is lined with healthy, protective bacteria?
questions.explanation: The internal vaginal canal is an extraordinary self-cleaning environment—no special soaps needed!

questions.text: Which self-regulating acidic level does a healthy vagina maintain to naturally protect itself against harmful bacteria and infections?
questions.explanation: The vagina maintains a naturally acidic environment driven by beneficial Lactobacillus bacteria to ward off pathogens.

questions.text: What flexible ring-shaped structure serves as the doorway or bridge connecting the vagina to the uterus?
questions.explanation: The cervix produces fluid that changes throughout your cycle to assist or block sperm and widens to 10 cm during childbirth.

questions.text: What remarkable glands located near the vaginal opening are responsible for secreting lubricating fluid during arousal?
questions.explanation: Located on either side of the vaginal opening, these tiny powerhouses secrete fluid to keep things smooth and comfortable.

questions.text: Which term refers to the entire outer, visible female genitalia, including the labia, clitoral hood, and mons pubis?
questions.explanation: 'Vagina' refers strictly to the internal canal, while 'vulva' encompasses all the outer anatomical features.

questions.text: Which miraculous organs hold a female's entire lifetime supply of eggs, right from the moment she is born?
questions.explanation: Females are born with around 1 to 2 million immature eggs in their ovaries, containing all the genetic potential for future generations from day one.

questions.text: What type of super-supportive muscle group spans the bottom of the pelvis to cradle and support the bladder, uterus, and bowels?
questions.explanation: This hammock-like layer of muscles supports core stability, organ health, and sexual function.
